notes.title: Meet 1Day on September 30th
notes.notes:
If I could have you back again, even just one more day, what would I do?

‘Hi, my name is [b]Moonface[/b], and [b]Squareface[/b] was my best friend. We had squabbles and fights, yet we were still together.

But since he was gone, I realized that there must be other ways to solve the problems existed between us. 

I found that losing the game is not that bad, if he was winning...

I wish that the balance of friendship was always in balance...’


This is an independent artistic game, all the incomes will be used for the creation of my next work. Thx for your support!

The game included a variety of classic 2D playing technics-shooting, jumping, tank war, puzzle solving, etc. With delicate drawings, a reversal plot appears if the player full scored the beginning levels.
